summary.oneLiner: Advait Energy surged 160% YoY in H1 revenue driven by record EPC and PTS orders, with BESS and green hydrogen manufacturing now scaling up; the July 2026 integrated facility commissioning will unlock 300MW electrolyzer capacity and 100Cr stringing tool output, transforming the company from a project executor to a vertically integrated energy transition player.

one-line thesis: Advait Energy surged 160% YoY in H1 revenue driven by record EPC and PTS orders, with BESS and green hydrogen manufacturing now scaling up; the July 2026 integrated facility commissioning will unlock 300MW electrolyzer capacity and 100Cr stringing tool output, transforming the company from a project executor to a vertically integrated energy transition player.
financial scorecard: revenue: +160% YoY (H1: INR275Cr); EBITDA/margin: +87% YoY, 11.3% (H1), 25% (Q2); PAT (rptd): +163% YoY (Q2: INR11.87Cr); PAT (normalized): not disclosed; order book: INR1,000Cr+ (76% PTS, 24% NRE); net debt: debt-equity 0.24x, no material increase, funded via debt
guidance: revenue growth: 50-60% YoY expected; margin: PTS 14-16% EBITDA, NRE improving; order inflow: strong pipeline in Malaysia, Ethiopia, Kazakhstan; capex/commissioning: INR100Cr+ capex completed by July 2026; 10MW electrolyzer by Jan 2026, 300MW by Q3-Q4 FY27
order book & pipeline: INR1,000Cr+ total; PTS: INR777.86Cr (RDSS: INR270Cr, ERS: INR22.45Cr, OPGW: INR3.54Cr, Tools: INR5.97Cr); NRE: BESS INR137.38Cr, Solar EPC INR119.90Cr, GH2 EPC INR3.14Cr
segment / subsidiary detail: PTS: ERS order book INR22.45Cr, OPGW LiveLine INR3.54Cr, stringing tools INR5.97Cr, RDSS INR270Cr; NRE: BESS order INR137.38Cr (first INR50-60Cr revenue Mar-Jun 2026), Solar EPC INR119.90Cr, Green Hydrogen EPC INR3.14Cr; manufacturing: 10MW electrolyzer by Jan 2026, 300MW by end FY27
growth verticals / optionality: Overseas expansion in Malaysia (INR12-15Cr OPGW LiveLine), Ethiopia, Kazakhstan; BESS DC block manufacturing by FY27; patented products in pipeline; PLI eligibility for electrolyzers from FY27-31
margins & cost dynamics: PTS margins stable at 14-16% EBITDA; NRE margins improving from low base; cost pressures mitigated by vertical integration and capex completion by July 2026; no raw material inflation concerns cited
capex / expansion: INR100Cr+ capex tied up for integrated facility at Gangad (35km from Ahmedabad); completion by July 2026; includes 350 towers/year ERS capacity, stringing tools capacity expansion to INR100Cr/year, 10MW then 300MW electrolyzer capacity
capital allocation: Capex fully funded via debt; no equity raise planned; reinvestment into AGPL (INR54Cr invested in subsidiary for electrolyzer/BESS); no dividends or buybacks mentioned; focus on scaling manufacturing and order execution
risks & watch-items: High trade receivables (INR60Cr increase in H1); margin compression risk in NRE if BESS projects underperform; execution risk on 300MW electrolyzer timeline; regulatory delays in PLI disbursement; PSU payment cycles
management quality / tone: Confident, aggressive, and vertically integrated; management emphasizes execution capability, technology partnerships, and long-term manufacturing scale; dismisses PSU dependency risks; proactive on IP and overseas expansion; tone is bullish on energy transition tailwinds
non-obvious takeaways: Company holds exclusive Asia-Pacific licensing rights for patented fuel cell/electrolyzer tech from global partners; first Indian company to complete two green hydrogen EPC projects; 46Cr of 'withheld money' reclassified as current asset indicates strong project completion pipeline

themes.title: Power transmission & renewable-evacuation capex
themes.need: Grid build-out to evacuate ~90 GW of new renewables is the broadest theme in the universe - pulling EHV/765kV transmission EPC, towers, conductors, OPGW, cables and HVDC. POWERGRID/ADANIENSOL TBCB pipeline plus state RDSS/underground-cabling capex (Rajesh Power 544291, OMPOWER) underpins multi-year visibility for EPC, tower (KP Green 544150, SKIPPER) and conductor/cable makers (KEI, RRKABEL, DYCL).
themes.driver: Fresh TBCB awards + execution ramp; EPC order inflows over next 1-2 quarters.
